reference.title: Time Delays in Linear Systems
reference.section: Transport Delay in MIMO Transfer Function

mapping.supportedSubset: Continuous double-precision 2x2 transfer matrix with one denominator per output row and grid-aligned output-by-input delays.
intentionalDeviations: The Process Lab MIMO Transfer Function uses one denominator polynomial per output row.
Expected samples are generated analytically and are not MATLAB or Simulink output.

oracle.description: Each output is the sum of independently delayed first-order step responses derived from the documented output-by-input IODelay semantics.
